a2_amendment: A2 is discovery: full grid + marginal sweeps allowed; K<=5 freeze deferred to A3; staged E→X→R not required as sole method.
eval_end_rationale: Last calendar day with date < T_primary so A2 selection uses no post_etf / no H2024 bars. H2020 segment is truncated ~3 months before next halving.

assumptions.reentry_mode_note: Exit at most once per cycle at dsh>=X; remain flat until next cycle_id; then wait R_wait days before DCA. threshold_repeat (intra-cycle re-exit) is rejected as mismatched to strategy intent.
